## Summary
Build a hybrid item search API (semantic + fulltext + structured filters) and an item bank management UI that lets faculty find, view, filter, and manage assessment items across their institution's item pool.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to search my institution's item bank by keyword, semantic similarity, Bloom level, USMLE system, and difficulty, so that I can find specific questions for manual exam curation or identify items for remixing.

## Why this matters
With hundreds or thousands of approved items, faculty need a search interface that goes beyond simple text matching. Semantic search finds conceptually related items even when they use different terminology (e.g., "heart failure" vs "cardiac decompensation"). Without structured filters, faculty waste time scrolling through irrelevant results. Missing institution_id filtering would expose other institutions' proprietary items (FERPA violation).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] GET /api/items?q=... performs hybrid search (semantic + fulltext combined via RRF)
- [ ] GET /api/items supports structured filters: bloom_level, system_code, difficulty, status
- [ ] GET /api/items supports pagination: page, per_page (default 20, max 50)
- [ ] GET /api/items/[id] returns full item detail with hub connections
- [ ] Semantic search uses text-embedding-3-small embeddings via pgvector HNSW
- [ ] Fulltext search uses Postgres tsvector on item stem + explanation
- [ ] Results ranked by reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) of semantic + fulltext scores
- [ ] All results filtered by institution_id (multi-tenant isolation via RLS)
- [ ] ItemSearchBank UI shows search bar + filter sidebar + paginated results grid
- [ ] Each result card shows: stem preview, Bloom level, USMLE system, difficulty, status badge
- [ ] API returns 403 for non-faculty roles

## Schema changes
```sql
-- Add tsvector column + HNSW index for hybrid search
-- (May already exist from E05 — check before applying)
ALTER TABLE assessment_items ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS search_vector tsvector
  GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', coalesce(stem, '') || ' ' || coalesce(explanation, ''))) STORED;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assessment_items_search ON assessment_items USING GIN (search_vector);

-- HNSW index for semantic search (pgvector)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assessment_items_embedding ON assessment_items
  USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
  WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64);

-- After adding: pnpm db:types
```

## API contract
```
GET /api/items?q={search_text}&bloom_level={1-6}&system_code={code}&difficulty={easy|medium|hard}&status={approved|draft|rejected}&page={1}&per_page={20}
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response: {
  data: {
    items: Array<{
      id: string,
      stem_preview: string,  // first 200 chars
      bloom_level: number,
      system_code: string,
      system_name: string,
      difficulty: string,
      status: string,
      score: number  // RRF combined score
    }>,
    pagination: {
      page: number,
      per_page: number,
      total: number,
      total_pages: number
    }
  },
  error: null
}

GET /api/items/[id]
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response: {
  data: {
    id: string,
    stem: string,
    choices: Array<{ id: string, text: string }>,
    correct_answer: string,
    explanation: string,
    bloom_level: number,
    difficulty: string,
    status: string,
    hubs: {
      subconcept: { id: string, name: string } | null,
      slo: { id: string, description: string } | null,
      usmle_subtopic: { id: string, name: string, system: string } | null
    },
    created_at: string
  },
  error: null
}
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// app/api/items/route.ts — hybrid search with RRF
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'  // Rule 1

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url)
  const q = searchParams.get('q') ?? ''
  const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') ?? '1')
  const perPage = Math.min(parseInt(searchParams.get('per_page') ?? '20'), 50)

  // Hybrid search: semantic + fulltext via RPC
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('hybrid_item_search', {
    query_text: q,
    query_embedding: q ? await getEmbedding(q) : null,
    bloom_filter: searchParams.get('bloom_level'),
    system_filter: searchParams.get('system_code'),
    difficulty_filter: searchParams.get('difficulty'),
    status_filter: searchParams.get('status'),
    page_num: page,
    page_size: perPage,
    rrf_k: 60  // reciprocal rank fusion constant
  })

  return NextResponse.json({ data: { items: data, pagination: { page, per_page: perPage } }, error: null })
}

// Supabase RPC function for hybrid search (in migration)
// CREATE FUNCTION hybrid_item_search(...) RETURNS TABLE(...)
// Combines semantic cosine similarity rank + BM25 ts_rank
// Uses RRF: score = 1/(k + rank_semantic) + 1/(k + rank_fulltext)
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ Data Layer: service_role key in browser search component
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'  // BANNED in 'use client'

// ✗ Missing institution_id filter (FERPA violation)
const { data } = await supabase.from('assessment_items').select('*')
// WRONG — must filter by institution_id (RLS handles it, but explicit filter is defense-in-depth)

// ✗ Client-side search without server-side filtering
// Never send all items to the client and filter in JS
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E06/E06-S06.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000'

test('Acceptance: GET /api/items returns paginated results', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items?page=1&per_page=10`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.items.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10)
  expect(data.pagination.page).toBe(1)
  expect(data.pagination.per_page).toBe(10)
})

test('Acceptance: semantic search returns relevant results', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items?q=cardiac+arrhythmia`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.items.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  // Top result should be related to cardiology
  expect(data.items[0].system_code).toBe('cardiovascular')
})

test('Acceptance: structured filters work', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items?bloom_level=3&difficulty=medium`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  for (const item of data.items) {
    expect(item.bloom_level).toBe(3)
    expect(item.difficulty).toBe('medium')
  }
})

test('Acceptance: GET /api/items/[id] returns full detail with hubs', async ({ request }) => {
  const listRes = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items?per_page=1`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  const { data: listData } = await listRes.json()
  const itemId = listData.items[0].id

  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items/${itemId}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.id).toBe(itemId)
  expect(data.stem).toBeTruthy()
  expect(data.hubs).toBeDefined()
})

test('Negative: non-faculty gets 403', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_STUDENT_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403)
})

test('Negative: per_page capped at 50', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/items?per_page=100`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.pagination.per_page).toBe(50)
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_assessment_items_search; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_assessment_items_embedding; ALTER TABLE assessment_items DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS search_vector;` then `pnpm db:types`
2. Drop RPC: `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS hybrid_item_search;`
3. Remove files: `rm features/coverage-blueprint/components/ItemSearchBank.tsx features/coverage-blueprint/hooks/useItemSearch.ts`
4. Remove API routes: `rm -rf app/api/items/`
5. `git stash && git checkout develop`
